title and abstract.summary: The study examined patterns in species diversity and functional-trait diversity within bee communities across different habitat types (semi-natural habitat, organic farms, and conventional farms) in a California agroecosystem.

introduction.summary: The study measured the species and functional-trait diversity of bee communities across three different habitat types: organic farms, conventional farms, and adjacent natural habitat.

methods.summary: The study measured various life-history traits (body size, dietary specialization, nesting location, nest construction behaviour, phenology, sociality, and landscape-wide abundance) and calculated species richness and trait diversity for the bee communities across different sites.
